extracted.name: Quick and Easy Spinach Casserole
extracted.description: This quick and easy spinach casserole with cream of mushroom soup is baked with cream cheese and fried onions and makes a delicious addition to any meal.
ingredient_lines: 2 (10 ounce) packages frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
In a large bowl combine spinach, cream cheese, mushroom soup, and 1/2 of fried onions; mix well.
Transfer mixture to a 2-quart casserole dish and sprinkle with remaining fried onions.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until heated through.
